gloss: Tanabata bamboo decoration; decorated bamboo branch

definitions.gloss: Tanabata bamboo decoration; decorated bamboo branch
definitions.explanation: A branch of {笹|ささ} (bamboo grass) decorated with paper streamers, origami ornaments, and {短冊|たんざく} (strips of paper bearing wishes), displayed for the {七夕|たなばた} festival on July 7.

examples.japanese: {七夕|たなばた}の{笹飾|ささかざ}りを{作|つく}った。
{保育園|ほいくえん}の{玄関|げんかん}に{大|おお}きな{笹飾|ささかざ}りが{飾|かざ}ってあった。
examples.english: A large Tanabata bamboo decoration was displayed at the entrance of the daycare.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}を{書|か}いた{短冊|たんざく}を{笹飾|ささかざ}りに{結|むす}び{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: The children tied paper strips bearing their wishes to the bamboo decoration.

notes:
Compound of {笹|ささ} (bamboo grass) + {飾|かざ}り (decoration). A core symbol of the Tanabata festival; the decorated branch is traditionally floated down a river or burned after the festival to send the wishes to the heavens.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {笹飾|ささかざ}りを{作|つく}る: to make Tanabata bamboo decorations
- {笹飾|ささかざ}りを{飾|かざ}る: to display the decoration
- {笹飾|ささかざ}りに{短冊|たんざく}をつける: to attach wish strips to the decoration

TYPICAL ORNAMENTS:
- {短冊|たんざく}: paper strips bearing written wishes
- {吹|ふ}き{流|なが}し: paper streamers
- {折|お}り{鶴|づる}: origami cranes
- {網飾|あみかざ}り: paper-net ornaments symbolizing a fisherman's catch
